newsitem.title: USA: NRG Energy says Nordic Power to buy Bolivian stake.
newsitem.headline: NRG Energy says Nordic Power to buy Bolivian stake.

text.p: NRG Energy Inc, a unit of Northern States Power Co, said Monday it signed an agreement with a unit of Swedish state-owned utility Vattenfall AB regarding NRG's proposed purchase of Bolivian Power Co (COBEE).

The deal calls for Vattenfall's Nordic Power Invest AB unit to buy either up to 50 percent of COBEE's stock acquired in NRG's $43-a-share tender offer, or the number of shares that can be bought for an equity investment of $45 million plus part of a $60-million bridge loan, said an NRG spokesman.
Bolivian Power accepted NRG's buyout offer last month.
NRG buys independent power production facilities.
